correctness.rationale: For all k>=2, r>=k, m>=1, spectral Riesz idempotents correspond to positive-rank summands of E^{direct-sum m}. The lower cohomology H^(2j)(S^(2k)) vanishes for 0<j<k, so c_k(E^{direct-sum m})=m c_k(E) and nonzero c_k forces a rank >=k summand. Rank arithmetic gives the upper depth rm-k+1. The stable-range clutching isomorphism pi_(2k-1)U(k)->pi_(2k-1)U(rm) gives one rank-k summand plus rm-k trivial lines, achieving that bound. Bott integrality injectivity proves zero c_k means the original rank-r bundle is trivial. Equality rank arithmetic and H^2=0 prove exact Riesz subbundle profile; no experimental inference.
